title: Try urMQTT live
lead: A real urMQTT broker, running right now in a virtual machine, with this page as its client. Connect, subscribe to a topic, publish a message and watch it come back. Nothing to install.
limits.title: Read this first: it is a shared toy
limits.1: This is a shared test machine. It is reset without notice (it runs from memory, so a restart wipes everything) and there is no promise that it is up.
limits.2: Everything published here is public. Anyone who uses this page or the demo certificates can read every message on the topics below. Do not send anything private: no passwords, no personal data, no real device data.
limits.3: Small limits apply: messages up to {payload} bytes, at most {subs} subscriptions, a few messages per second. Messages are not stored and retained messages are not kept; you only see what is sent while you are connected.
limits.4: You can use only the topics under demo/web/. Everything else is refused by the broker.
limits.5: Your browser talks to a small relay on this site, which passes the bytes to the broker. The broker sees the relay, not your address. This page sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts, and nothing is kept in your browser.
limits.6: Please be kind: the limits protect a small machine, and abuse ends the demo for everybody.
conn.title: 1. Connect
sub.title: 2. Subscribe
sub.hint: Everything you type goes after {prefix}. The wildcards + (one level) and # (the rest) work. The default is a random room name, so you see your own messages; use # to see everybody's.
pub.title: 3. Publish
pub.topic-hint: No wildcards. The topic is {prefix} plus what you type.
pub.payload-hint: At most {max} bytes. Public: do not send anything private.
pub.qos1: At least once (QoS 1, waits for the broker)
log.title: Messages
log.empty: Nothing yet. Connect, subscribe, then publish.
err.topic-long: The topic is too long (at most {max} bytes).
err.levels: The topic has too many levels (at most {max}).
err.chars: The topic contains a control character.
err.wildcard: A topic to publish to cannot contain + or #.
err.filter: A wildcard must be a whole level: + for one level, # as the last level.
err.already: You are already subscribed to this filter.
err.too-many-subs: At most {max} subscriptions at a time. Remove one first.
err.payload-long: The message is too long (at most {max} bytes).
err.slow-down: Slow down a little: a few messages per second at most.
real.title: Use a real MQTT client
real.p1: The same broker speaks MQTT over TLS 1.3 with a client certificate on {host}:8883. Download the demo certificates and the broker's CA, then, for example, listen to what this page publishes:
real.p2: The certificate named web sees the topics under demo/web/, like this page. Certificates named demo-001 and so on see demo/demo-001/ and so on. A client id must equal the certificate's name, and one certificate can be connected once at a time.
real.p3: The zip contains the private key of the demo client CA on purpose: anyone can make a certificate for this toy, so a certificate here proves nothing. Do not reuse it anywhere else.
noscript: This page needs JavaScript to run an MQTT client in your browser.
